Name: (CP) Silver Walnut
Author: tikamin557
Description:
[quote][color=#ff0000][size=6]Notes![/size][/color]
[size=4]If you install this mod with the [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/15198]JA version[/url]﻿﻿ of the old mod, unexpected problems may occur, so please be sure to delete the [color=#f4f4f4]JA version﻿[/color] files when installing this mod!
[/size](Please note that JA version items will no longer be available. They will be added to the game as another new item.)[/quote]

For saplings and machine recipes, open the island's traders and if Pierre's friendship level is high enough, you will receive an mail to start selling them.

The prices of saplings and machine recipes are set somewhat higher and the processing times on the machines are set longer so as not to obviously break the game balance.


[color=#00ff00][size=6]Regarding specification changes in Version 1.2.[/size][/color]
[size=3]Since a certain SDV update, it has become impossible to obtain a cumulative total of 130 or more Golden Walnuts.
Therefore, if you craft a Golden Walnut at the Maker after obtaining 130 items, that item will be placed in your inventory as “[color=#ffff00]Golden Walnut (Replacement)[/color]”.
[/size][size=3]And to allow you to exchange this for Qi Gems, we've also added an item to the Qi Shop.
This allows the mod to function in much the same way as before.[/size]
